story_text: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Cancel an already cancelled booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
2. Add a booking ID of a cancelled booking
positive.expected_result: Error stating this booking has already been cancelled

positive.title: Validate Cancel an already cancelled booking error message
steps: 1. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
2. Add a booking ID of a cancelled booking
positive.expected_result: Error stating this booking has already been cancelled

negative.title: Cancel a deleted booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
2. Add a booking ID of a deleeted booking
negative.expected_result: Error stating this booking is non-existent

edge.title: Cancelling a booking that was confirmed then cancelled
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Add a booking ID of a pending booking
4. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
5. Add a booking ID of a cancelled booking
edge.expected_result: Error stating this booking has already been cancelled
